WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales) AS web_net_sales FROM net_lines
  WHERE store_id = 900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, m.web_net_sales, c.net_sales AS control, c.net_sales_before_returns, c.returns_net
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN mine m ON m.business_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales c ON c.business_date = d.calendar_date AND c.store_id = 900
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'dup_sales_key' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(c-1) AS extra FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', COUNT(*), SUM(c-1) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_return_id', COUNT(*), SUM(c-1) FROM (SELECT return_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_web_order', COUNT(*), SUM(c-1) FROM (SELECT web_order_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'delivered_null_dispatch', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_no_order', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_nondispatched_status', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_to_web_with_orig_nonweb', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'

WITH o AS (
  SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date,
         CAST(dispatch_ts_utc AS DATE) AS dispatch_utc_date, status, fulfilment_type
  FROM fact_web_order)
SELECT d AS day,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE order_date=d AND status<>'cancelled') AS orders_placed,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE order_date=d AND status='cancelled') AS cancelled,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE order_date=d AND status='processing') AS processing,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE dispatch_date=d) AS dispatched_helsinki,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE dispatch_utc_date=d) AS dispatched_utc,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE dispatch_date=d AND fulfilment_type='click_and_collect') AS cc_dispatched,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id) JOIN dim_store sr ON sr.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_store sf ON sf.store_key=f.store_key WHERE r.return_date=d AND sf.store_id=900 AND sr.store_id<>900) AS web_returns_booked_elsewhere,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id) JOIN dim_store sr ON sr.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_store sf ON sf.store_key=f.store_key WHERE r.return_date=d AND sf.store_id<>900 AND sr.store_id=900) AS store_returns_booked_web
FROM (SELECT CAST(x AS DATE) AS d FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-12-13', DATE '2025-12-25', INTERVAL 1 DAY) t(x))
ORDER BY 1
